evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3530164 ($49.00, product W, in_person) scores 0.10 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.40.
Card baseline from 980 earlier transactions: median $67.91, 95th percentile $425.08; the flagged amount is 0.7x the median.
Billing region 330 is among the 53 regions in this card's history.

Cardholder C08623 reported the $49.00 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2016-12-10 15:01:21). Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (1.00). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 2.36x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.70). Weighted equally: 0.85.
Out-of-region use: card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Out of region use on card C08623-K2: 2 transaction(s) from 2016-12-10 to 2016-12-10 totalling $165.93, probability 0.85.
